semanticDispositions: All12 exact source IDs/primary readings/N5/types/kanji/tags remain stable; preserve every Japanese example, reading, form and substantive teaching point. Optional absent link wrappers alone may go. No invented provider, syllabus or N1 coverage.
あびる stays the kana ID/kanji[] although ordinary written浴びる is taught. Preserve ichidan/transitive/を, exposure to water/light and unwanted attention/criticism, not only bathtub washing.

シャワー stays a noun-only-supported katakana loanword, with smallャ and the final long-vowel mark; facility and bathing action remain distinct uses. A Russian принимать comparison may replace the Englishtake comparison without inventing a Japanese wrong collocation.

お風呂/風呂 preserve bath/tub/facility context,に入る notを入る, politeお and typical washing-before-soaking qualification. Gogen actually read49–58 says origins are uncertain,室 theory somewhat favored; no established wind-plus-character etymology or origin certainty. Sourcewago follows that disputed account.

お手洗い preserves polite ordinary restroom use, handwashing formation and the fact thatお does not assert socially superior ownership. Preserve source facilities ID and record the pinned app gap separately.

トイレ preserves toilet/facility/use, three-kana abbreviation ofトイレット with no length mark, return implied by行ってきます and register contrast with便所. The Russian intended-meaning qualifier is not permission to drop source activity/facility senses or import all meanings of a related long form.

せっけん remains sourcekango/kanji[]; preserve石けん/石鹸 variants, smallっ and meansで versus objectを. The Russian soap qualifier excludes independently attested Russian camera/soap-opera/blur/email homonyms, not physical soap senses.

洗う preserves physical wash/cleanse/rinse, hands/dishes/clothes, transitiveを, godan forms and the distinction between omitted object and intransitivity. Do not make Japanese particles equivalent to Russian cases.

洗濯 preserves noun/suru laundry, both洗濯をする/洗濯する, objects withを, potential home-washing example and washing-machine/laundry derivatives. API and modernDaijisen also recordせんだく; do not state it is impossible. Named modern and精選 rest senses are C2 evidence, not silently added N5 teaching; historical/dialect clothing or alternateあらいすすぎ notes are not automatic new ordinary N5 senses.

掃除 is naturally captionedуборка, not a mechanically broad clean translation. The complete lesson still preserves sweeping/dusting/scrubbing, transitiveする/を, desire-not-plan inしたくありません,ソウ+ジ/long vowel, objects as well as spaces, tidying versus dirt removal and method/tool independence.

歯 preservesは, unmarked Japanese number, back-tooth versus invented wisdom-tooth distinction,歯科/歯医者/歯磨き and the noun/action distinction. Exact-written age candidates are direct C2 evidence, not promoted primary readings or unsupported frequency claims.

磨く preserves physical rubbing/brushing/polishing, teeth/shoes, all godan forms includingいて,洗う/拭く distinctions and技術を磨く honing. Remove only English-dependentbrush analogy; retain Japanese non-generalization to hair brushing without inventing a new Japanese hair collocation.
